notice: Reference for the Railway template editor. This is NOT a Railway import format. The editor creates the deployable multi-service template.
name: Dolibarr
description: Deploy Dolibarr ERP & CRM with private MariaDB, persistent files and modules, automatic setup, and optional scheduled jobs.

MARIADB_USER.description: Application database user; no root privileges.

MARIADB_PASSWORD.description: Generated database password; referenced by Dolibarr. Do not regenerate on an existing database.

MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Independent generated database root password. Keep private; not used by Dolibarr.

PORT.description: HTTP port; set the generated Railway domain target to 80 too.

DOLI_DB_HOST.description: Private database DNS; keep both services in the same project environment.

DOLI_DB_HOST_PORT.description: Private MariaDB TCP port, not the public proxy port.

DOLI_DB_NAME.description: Database name from the MariaDB service.

DOLI_DB_PASSWORD.description: Reference the generated database password; do not generate another one here.

DOLI_URL_ROOT.description: Public HTTPS URL. Set a full https:// URL when switching to a custom domain.

DOLI_ADMIN_LOGIN.description: Initial administrator login. Letters, digits, _, ., @ and - only.

DOLI_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Generated first-install password. Read this variable to log in; later changes belong in Dolibarr.

DOLI_INSTANCE_UNIQUE_ID.description: Permanent instance encryption key. Back it up and never regenerate it for an existing installation.

DOLI_COMPANY_NAME.description: Your company name; initializes the company on first installation. Change later in Dolibarr.

DOLI_COMPANY_COUNTRYCODE.description: Two-letter company country code; defaults to France.

DOLI_INSTALL_AUTO.description: Initialize the empty database automatically; keep 1.

DOLI_INIT_DEMO.description: No sample customers or invoices; keep 0 for real business use.

DOLI_CRON.description: Upstream cron-only mode must stay 0 so Apache runs.

DOLI_RAILWAY_CRON.description: Optional in-container scheduler: set 1 after enabling Scheduled Jobs in Dolibarr.

DOLI_CRON_KEY.description: Scheduler key. Also set it in the Dolibarr Scheduled Jobs module when enabling cron.

DOLI_CRON_USER.description: User running scheduled jobs; firstadmin selects an active administrator. Prefer a dedicated user later.

PHP_INI_DATE_TIMEZONE.description: PHP timezone. Choose another IANA zone when needed.

PHP_INI_MEMORY_LIMIT.description: PHP memory per request, not the Railway service memory limit.

PHP_INI_POST_MAX_SIZE.description: POST limit; must exceed the per-file upload limit.
